products.description: MCP server: code graph + memory + knowledge in one binary. 23 tools across 3 domains. Stores injected edges that grep never sees. Absorbed wicked-brain (retired 2026-08): indexes codebase knowledge + memories, surfaced through wicked-garden's mem/search skill domains.

install.mcpInstructions: Index a repo first: wicked-estate index <path> --db ~/.wicked-estate/graph.db. Then add wicked-estate as an MCP server in your CLI config with command: wicked-estate-mcp (both binaries install to ~/.cargo/bin — ensure it is on PATH)

products.description: Local-first SQLite event bus. At-least-once delivery, push-over-durable-poll, no network transport. Decouples agents and tools without external infrastructure.

RETIRED (2026-08, v0.11.0 final). QE capabilities (40 specialist skills + acceptance trio) have moved to wicked-garden's qe domain. The acceptance gate is now wicked-crew. Data layer is wicked-ledger + wicked-vault. Install wicked-garden and wicked-crew instead.
products.note: Retired. npm package deprecated at 0.11.0. Do not install — use wicked-garden (qe domain) + wicked-crew instead.

products.description: RETIRED (2026-08, Phase 5-S7). Memory, knowledge, and search capabilities consolidated into wicked-estate. The npm package is deprecated. Use wicked-estate (memory + knowledge domains) via wicked-garden's mem/search skills instead.
products.note: Retired. npm package deprecated. Use wicked-estate instead — it ships all memory/knowledge/search capabilities. ~/.wicked-brain on disk is a frozen archive; never delete it.

products.description: Local-first evidence primitive — records claim-backing evidence with its acceptance criteria, re-derives integrity deterministically, and records independent third-party judgments. Internal infrastructure peer, not a marketed product: it is the honest-evidence backend wicked-garden's gate requires.
products.note: Dependency, not a standalone product — installed automatically when wicked-garden is selected (garden's evidence gate blocks without it).

products.description: Curated toolkit for what coding agents can't do alone: re-derives 'done' from evidence, sees injected edges, renames across files as a graph operation, multi-model review, 40-specialist QE domain, mem/search via wicked-estate. Opinionated bundle — all or nothing.

install.mcpInstructions: Run /wicked-garden-core setup in Claude Code to complete configuration (verifies peers; blocks only on wicked-vault, the one the evidence gate needs).

products.note: Opinionated bundle — you get everything. Individual components cannot be disabled.

products.description: Design and vibe canvas for creating self-contained, single-file interactive HTML artifacts. Presentation builder, artifact creator, and narrative content tool. Export as a self-contained HTML file that runs anywhere.

Coder-facing browser console for wicked-crew — launch/steer governed runs, answer HITL gates, view live agent streams and evidence. Pure HTTP/WS client of crew's API. Ships bundled inside wicked-crew (npx wicked-crew serve opens the UI); also available as a standalone repo for custom deployments.

install.instructions: Wicked Studio ships bundled inside Wicked Crew — install wicked-crew and run `wicked-crew serve` to get the Studio console. For custom deployments, the standalone repo is mikeparcewski/wicked-studio.

products.description: Governed multi-agent runs for the coding CLIs you already have. Evaluator is never the creator. Deny-dominates dual gates. 'Done' re-derived from evidence, never asserted. Launch a run, watch every agent stream, answer steering gates, export the evidence bundle. Ships with Wicked Studio console.

bundles.description: Crew + Bus — the fastest way to run a governed multi-agent session. Install crew, start the daemon, open the Studio console, and launch a run in under five minutes.
The recommended starting point for Claude Code users. Bus + Garden gives you evidence-gated work, graph-aware refactoring, multi-model review, and the full QE skill domain.
Estate + Bus — the persistent memory, knowledge, and code-graph layer. Everything else queries it. Surfaced through wicked-garden's mem/search skill domains.
Wicked Interactive + Crew — the creative and operator surfaces. Build self-contained HTML artifacts and get live visibility into AI workflow sessions via the Studio console that ships inside Crew.
Everything active — bus, estate, garden, interactive, and crew (which includes the Studio console). The complete wicked-* experience.
